articles.summary: Valvoline Inc. (NYSE: VVV), the quick, easy, trusted leader in preventive automotive maintenance, today announced that it plans to report financial results for its fiscal fourth quarter on November 19, 2026. A live audio webcast with analysts and investors will also be held on November 19, 2026 at 9 a.m. ET. The webcast and slide presentation will be available on the company’s Investor Relations website at http://investors.valvoline.com . Shortly after the call concludes, a replay of the webcast will be available on this same website. About Valvoline Inc. Valvoline Inc. (NYSE: VVV) delivers quick, easy, trusted service at approximately 2,500 franchised and company-operated service centers across the United States and Canada. The Company completes more than 30 million services annually system-wide, from about 15-minute stay-in-your-car oil changes to a variety of manufacturer-recommended maintenance services such as wiper replacements and tire rotations. articles.summary: From 42 service centers to more than 2,500 locations across North America, Valvoline Inc. marks a milestone year Valvoline Inc. (NYSE: VVV), the quick, easy, trusted leader in preventive automotive maintenance, recognizes a milestone year marking 10 years as a public company and 40 years in the retail automotive services business. “Forty years ago, Valvoline Inc. entered retail with a simple idea to make routine vehicle care faster, easier, and more trusted for busy drivers,” said Lori Flees, President and Chief Executive Officer of Valvoline Inc. “That promise remains and these milestones are about more than longevity, they’re about the team members, franchisees, and customers who have helped shape our journey.
